items: ½ cup butter, at room temperature

steps.title: Cream the butter
steps.body: Beat until light and fluffy: **½ cup butter**, at room temperature, **½ brown sugar** and **¾ tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the flour and salt
steps.body: Combine and add to butter mixture: **1 cup flour** and **¼ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Bake the crust
steps.body: Press into a 9×9 pan and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes, until golden brown.

steps.title: Add the chocolate
steps.body: Immediately after removing from oven, top with **1 cup semisweet chocolate chips**.

steps.title: Melt the chocolate
steps.body: Place back in the oven for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Spread the chocolate
steps.body: Remove from oven, spread melted chocolate chips with a spatula, then sprinkle on top: **½ finely chopped toasted almonds**.

steps.title: Chill and cut
steps.body: Thoroughly chill before cutting into small rectangles.
